release_notes: Add runbook suggestion engine to incident-bot: on-call UI will now surface ranked runbook suggestions and suggested remediation actions, diagnostics context enriched with runbook metadata and SLO links. Telemetry tags added for suggestion tracking and latency micro-benchmark shows negligible impact.
description: Context: Oncall responders repeatedly ask for quick runbook suggestions and one-click suggested actions during incidents. This PR introduces a small ranking engine that surfaces relevant runbooks and suggested remediation actions directly in incident-bot diagnostics messages. Motivation: reduce time-to-first-action for oncall by surfacing targeted runbooks and measurable suggested steps. What changed: - runbook_suggester.py: new lightweight ranker that scores runbooks based on signal enrichment (SLO tags, recent edits, relevance to alert signature). The model is a simple weighted scorer configurable via incident-bot config. - context_enricher.py: enriches the incident diagnostic payload with runbook metadata, canonical runbook URL, SLO links, and a compact suggested action list extracted from runbook fragments. - oncall_handlers.py: integrates suggestions into the oncall message flow and adds a 'Apply suggested action' quick-button stub for future autofix integration. - telemetry/telemetry_instrumentation.py: new telemetry keys (runbook_id, suggestion_score, suggestion_source, suggestion_latency_ms) and events for suggestion_shown and suggestion_clicked. - tests: unit tests for suggester heuristics, enrichment edge cases, and telemetry emission. - docs: updates to docs/oncall-runbooks.md with configuration knobs and example outputs. Operational notes: - Ranking params moved to config with safe defaults to avoid noisy suggestions in the first rollout. - Runbook URL sanitization and fallback to 'no-runbook-found' when metadata is missing. - Feature is behind a feature-flag (oncall.runbook_suggestions) so rollout can be controlled per-cluster. CI: All unit/integration/e2e checks pass locally and in CI. Performance: micro-benchmark shows ~1.8ms median added latency to diagnostics path under nominal load; end-to-end impact validated in staging. Rollout plan: enable feature-flag for SRE alpha team for one week, monitor suggestion click-rate and false-positive reports, then gradually expand to all oncall. Related: ENG-1428, SRE-621, SUP-9412.
